correctness.rationale: The strict positive parameter witness and both clipping inequalities are exact. Substitution makes all five differential equations vanish. Symbolic differentiation yields the full rational 5x5 Jacobian. Its monic quintic has nonzero Routh pivots with signs +,+,+,-,+,+, proving exactly two open-right-half-plane eigenvalues; the frozen 3x3 principal block satisfies the cubic Hurwitz criterion. The included verifier reproduces all statements directly. No nonlinear Hopf or periodic orbit is asserted.

originality.rationale: The original model and preprint were read in their relevant analyses: each computes a 3x3 population Jacobian despite five actual feedback states, and the published Theorem 7 uses its cubic to draw an endemic-stability conclusion. The exact full-five-equation counterexample is absent from those inspected results. Searches of source IDs, aliases, full Jacobian, rate balances, and related feedback literatures did not reveal equivalent or logically stronger published coverage; broader oscillatory phenomena are known in genuinely different models.
residual_risks: Unindexed or unpublished independent work may have the same specific five-state witness; semantic search cannot prove absolute uniqueness.
The published model admits many feedback functions, so this finding applies specifically to the two source functions chosen in its simulations and not every permitted function.
The related 2023 age-structured and 2024 Preisach papers were checked at the accessible article-record level only; no whole-document novelty certification is claimed for those distinct models.
Linear spectral instability does not establish a nonlinear periodic orbit or a Hopf bifurcation.

value.rationale: An exact interior endemic witness reverses the qualitative stability of the distinctive source-specific five-variable system despite a Hurwitz three-population Jacobian. This identifies a scientifically motivated structural gap in using a frozen-rate analysis to characterize feedback-driven epidemic dynamics; it is not an arbitrary parameter slice, trivial numerical gain, or generic rediscovery of oscillations.
